svg.title: Indochine interlock network
svg.text: 25 firms in 11 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 519 firms, 6,040 interlocks, 12 components (largest 494). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 110 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
